name: migrate
description: Bulk migrate all guests on the cluster.

params.name: max-workers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently.

params.name: maxworkers
params.description: Defines the maximum number of tasks running concurrently. Deprecated, use 'max-workers' instead.

params.name: online
params.description: Enable live migration for VMs and restart migration for CTs.

params.name: vms
params.description: Only consider guests from this list of VMIDs.

params.name: with-local-disks
params.description: Enable live storage migration for local disk

permissions.description: The 'VM.Migrate' permission is required on '/' or on '/vms/<ID>' for each ID passed via the 'vms' parameter.
